name: SUMA Acquisition Corporation Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: SUMA Acquisition Corp. operates as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), established with the objective of completing a business combination, such as a merger, asset acquisition, share exchange, or other form of reorganization, with one or more entities. Naseem Saloojee and David King founded this company on November 21, 2025, and its primary operations are based in Toronto, Canada.
